planned_title: Why Did a 90-Day Mars Rover Last 14 Years?
replaces_for_review: wed11_opening_testA_v02 (scheduled TtgHNLXfDSs). v01, v02 and v03 not overwritten.
spoken: 14 years. on Mars. This rover was built to last 90 days Dust should have choked its solar panels within months. Martian wind kept sweeping them clean. The team called them cleaning events. Each one gave the rover back its power, and it kept driving. Then in 2018, a storm wrapped the whole planet and the sky went dark.
loop_sentence: …and the sky went dark. Fourteen years on Mars.
